scope: Read-only installed OpenCode 2.2.5 static callpath and public authored smoke evidence; no model, authentication, API, task/gold, or credential reads.
decision: No material blocker to authored E2E and development tasks with the installed bounded MCP poll plus shared one-second stabilization heuristic.

findings.fact: GET /api/mcp can return pending while initial connection runs asynchronously. The observed static-stage1 no-model failure recorded pending. Polling missing/pending with a bound, and rejecting terminal status, addresses this failure.

MCP connection fetches and assigns tools before setting connected. Native McpTool subsequently updates its registration on mcp.tools.changed through a 100 ms debounce; its flush waits the initial registration fiber only. Thus connected is insufficient proof that a future first request includes the native MCP tool.

REST session.context returns decoded stored messages, not SessionContext.select/load prepared tool definitions. Internal Tool.snapshot synchronously rebuilds an invalidated registry but does not drain the pending debounce. No public native-tool catalog completion endpoint was found in the installed OpenAPI/callpath.

The authored model smoke first claimed the tool unavailable, then later invoked research_memory_memory_lookup successfully and admitted the omission. Public evidence contains no first-request tool definition snapshot. A registry race and model omission both remain possible; the pre-edit-query criterion remains unmet.

patch_review.poll: Appropriate for the observed pending failure; before session creation/model admission.
patch_review.stabilization: Installed worker sleeps one second identically across all arms before POST session, records actual elapsed time and explicitly denies completion-proof semantics. Practical heuristic accepted; long scheduler stalls could exceed it.

limitations: No actual first-request model tool catalog was exposed in saved evidence.
The one-second interval is not a guaranteed catalog-readiness acknowledgement.
No new model or authentication calls were run.
